# Intentional, reviewed contract changes: METHOD PATH and the oasdiff message.

# P2: the guest upgrade returns crm.Customer; the spec now names that type instead of the Customer
# resource schema that used to replace it (generator reserves resource schema names). Wire format unchanged.
POST /api/v1/crm/guests/{id}:upgrade the `code` response property's maxLength was unset from `40` for the response status `201`
POST /api/v1/crm/guests/{id}:upgrade the `email` response property's maxLength was unset from `254` for the response status `201`
POST /api/v1/crm/guests/{id}:upgrade the `name` response property's maxLength was unset from `160` for the response status `201`
POST /api/v1/crm/guests/{id}:upgrade the `phone` response property's maxLength was unset from `40` for the response status `201`
POST /api/v1/crm/guests/{id}:upgrade the `birthDate` response's property `format` changed from `date` to `date-time` for status `201`
POST /api/v1/crm/guests/{id}:upgrade the `email` response's property `format` changed from `email` to `none` for status `201`
POST /api/v1/crm/guests/{id}:upgrade removed the required property `createdAt` from the response with the `201` status
POST /api/v1/crm/guests/{id}:upgrade removed the required property `updatedAt` from the response with the `201` status
